excursions.title: KAYAK, HIKE AND SNORKEL ON CAS CAY
excursions.highlights:
• Explore the biodiversity of Cas Cay, an island in a wildlife refuge and marine sanctuary.
  • Kayak and snorkel through the waters surrounding the uninhabited island.
  • Look for wildlife above and below the water’s surface, which the guide will describe.
  • Hike around the island, exploring the beaches, tidal pools and inland terrain.
excursions.description: Kayak and snorkel through the crystal-clear waters surrounding Cas Cay and then hike around the uninhabited, boomerang-shaped island, which lies within the St. Thomas Mangrove Wildlife Refuge and Marine Sanctuary. Your two-person kayak will be easy to paddle, allowing you to concentrate on the scenery, which is extraordinary. Red mangrove trees grow right to the water’s edge, and chances are you will spot all sorts of water birds in the intertwined aboveground roots. The guide will describe how the mangroves filter sediments, stabilize the shorelines and provide a nesting and breeding habitat for fish and sea turtles. You will see much of this marine life while snorkeling just off Cas Cay, where starfish, pufferfish and stingrays are abundant. Afterwards, you can explore the island on foot by following the trails inland and around the coast. The tidal pools are particularly well worth a look, as different marine creatures inhabit them.
excursions.hint:
• Dress in weather-appropriate clothing, including long pants.
  • Wear a swimsuit under your clothes and bring a towel and sunscreen.
  • Wear flat comfortable waterproof shoes.
excursions.disclaimer: This tour is only recommended for active guests in good physical condition. This tour is not recommended for guests with limited mobility or guests who utilize a wheelchair.  Gatorade, water, snacks, snorkeling and safety gear, and a dry bag are included.  Paddling and snorkeling instructions are also provided; no experience is necessary to participate.  Guests are advised to wear a swimsuit under a cover-up, waterproof shoes, sunscreen, a hat, sunglasses and bring a towel from the ship. The maximum weight to participate on this tour is 275 pounds. This tour is not suitable for guests with mobility issues or using molbility assiting devices. Full faced snorkel mask are prohibited on this tour. Max age restriction is 70 years old.

excursions.title: SHIPWRECK AND TURTLE COVE
excursions.highlights:
• Sail the catamaran Castaway Girl to Buck Island while admiring the gorgeous scenery.
  • Snorkel the crystal-clear waters at Shipwreck Cove, which is teeming with marine life.
  • See a wartime shipwreck that lies just 25 feet below the surface of the water.
  • Enjoy an open bar and Caribbean music on the return cruise.
excursions.description: Hoist the sails and set a course south on a comfortable, exclusive catamaran. This upscale sail and snorkel tours starts with a scenic one hour motor-sail out to Buck Island, a fish and birdlife private island sanctuary. Your attentive crew will point out island highlights, serve you sodas, water and advise you about your snorkeling adventure. You'll visit two different snorkel areas- Shipwreck and Turtle Bay- both located on Buck Island, conditions permitting. You will have ample time at each of these different snorkel sites to explore. After receiving your modern snorkel gear, safety vest and snorkle instruction, your crew will lead a guided tour through this underwater haven of abundant marine life, coral formations and colorful sea-life. Keep an eye out for an inquisitive Turtle, rays, and maybe even a shipwreck. After more than an hour at this paradise island you'll set sail for the return into beautiful Charlotte Amalie Harbor. Enjoy snacks, along with complimentary tropical rum punch. Relax during your delightful sail in blue Caribbean waters, with stunning scenery and Caribbean music.
excursions.hint:
• Dress in weather-appropriate clothing.
  • Wear a swimsuit under your clothes and bring a towel and sunscreen.
  • Wear flat comfortable walking shoes.
excursions.disclaimer: All snorkeling equipment, instruction, drinks and snacks are included in the tour. Guests must be at least 21 years of age to be served alcoholic beverages. Alcoholic beverages will be served only after water activities are completed. Guests are advised to wear a swimsuit under a cover-up, sunscreen, a hat, sunglasses and bring a towel from the ship. This tour is not recommended for guests with mobility concerns, recent back or neck injuries, heart conditions, epilepsy, diabetes, respiratory conditions or pregnant women. There is a weight restriction of 300 pounds. Max age restriction is 70 years old.

excursions.title: ST. JOHN TRUNK BAY BEACH & SNORKEL
excursions.highlights:
• Take a scenic ferry ride over to the pristine island of St. John.
  • Drive through a naturally beautiful national park on the way to Trunk Bay.
  • Relax on the beach in whatever way you find most pleasurable.
  • Follow an unusual snorkeling path with underwater signs that describe the marine life.
excursions.description:
Cruise to neighboring St. John, the most naturally preserved of the U.S. Virgin Islands, where you may snorkel, sunbathe or simply relax at gorgeous Trunk Bay.

Depart directly from the pier, where you'll board a ferry boat and begin a narrated cruise along the spectacular southeastern shore of St. Thomas. You'll pass bay after bay, each one a jewel in its own right. Before long, you'll disembark in lovely Cruz Bay on nearby St. John, a magnificently pristine island, as 60% of it is protected national parkland.

After a leisurely drive through the verdant Virgin Islands National Park, with brief photo stops at Cruz Bay, Caneel Bay and Hawksnest Bay to capture the awe-inspiring scenery, you'll arrive at Trunk Bay. This stretch of soft, white sand is considered one of the world's most beautiful beaches, and no wonder. With a backdrop of coconut palms and flowering beach maho trees, the gently curving coastline and turquoise waters are mesmerizing.

Upon arrival you'll have a short, mandatory safety briefing and be given your snorkel equipment. After that, feel free to spend your time here doing whatever you please. Sunbathe on the beach. Relax in the shade. Enjoy a snack at the beach concession or of course, take advantage of the marvelous snorkeling opportunities here. Just off shore in crystal clear waters, is a 225-yard snorkeling trail. The trail is a wonderfully unusual attraction with numerous underwater signs guiding the way and describing the marine life that is commonly seen in Trunk Bay. More than 30 species of fish thrive in these waters, including yellowtail snapper, French angelfish and colorful parrotfish.

After approximately 2-hours enjoying all that Trunk Bay has to offer, you'll rejoin your coach and drive back to Cruz Bay where you'll re-board the ferry and cruise back to the pier in Charlotte Amalie.
excursions.hint:
• Dress in weather-appropriate clothing.
  • Wear a swimsuit under your clothes and bring a towel and sunscreen.
  • Wear flat comfortable walking shoes or aqua socks.
excursions.disclaimer: Walking on this tour is mainly at the guests' discretion during the stops. There will be sandy and uneven surfaces to negotiate at Trunk Bay. Those who wish to snorkel should be good swimmers.  The tour is not available to wheelchair guests and pregnant women should consult with their doctor before snorkeling. Guests with any other medical conditions should check with their snorkel guide before entering the water. Those with mobility concerns are cautioned to carefully evaluate their personal level of stamina and ability. A swimsuit worn under a cover-up; sun cap; sunglasses; sunscreen; towel; and flat, comfortable walking shoes or aqua socks are recommended. Those guests participating in any water activities do so at their own risk and responsibility. Full faced snorkel mask are prohibited on this tour.

excursions.title: PANORAMIC VIEWS OF ST. THOMAS
excursions.highlights:
• Drive around St. Thomas on elevated roads that offer the most magnificent views.
  • Pause at scenic lookouts such as Drake’s Seat, which presents the ultimate harbor view.
  • Gaze out over St. Thomas from Mountain Top, the highest point on the island.
excursions.description: Settle in for a spectacularly scenic drive around St. Thomas, much of it on the elevated road Skyline Drive. As you begin to ascend into the hills, you will enjoy sweeping views of the sea and your cruise ship in the harbor. The higher you go, the more extraordinary the views. Occasional stops at the most picturesque vantage points will provide historical perspectives as well, as the guide will point out and describe the sights. For instance, the Drake’s Seat lookout is named for Sir Francis Drake, the English explorer and privateer that supposedly watched over the harbor from there in the late 1500s. For the ultimate bird’s-eye view, you will stop at Mountain Top, the highest point on St. Thomas. From there, you will be treated to panoramas of the island and the British Virgin Islands in the distance. Time will be allotted to shop and perhaps sip one of the venue’s famed banana daiquiris.
excursions.hint:
• Dress in weather-appropriate clothing.
  • Wear flat comfortable walking shoes or aqua socks.
excursions.disclaimer: This tour includes minimal walking. Guests need to be able to make their own way on and off the coach and tramway.Those with mobility concerns are cautioned to evaluate their personal level of stamina and ability. Maximum age to participate is 80 years of age. Casual, weather-appropriate clothing and comfortable, flat walking shoes are suggested.

excursions.title: ST. JOHN ISLAND TOUR
excursions.highlights:
• Ride the ferry to and from Cruz Bay on the neighboring island of St. John.
  • Marvel at the unspoiled natural beauty of St. John, two-thirds of which is national park.
  • Cruise along St. Thomas’ southern shore for a different perspective of tropical beauty.
excursions.description: Take the ferry to Cruz Bay on the neighboring island of St. John for a panoramic drive around this smallest but most naturally beautiful of the U.S. Virgin Islands. Two-thirds of St. John is protected national parkland that shelters an abundance of wildlife and endemic flora. While traveling through this natural wonderland, you will hear commentary that describes the island’s most prominent features, attractions and history. The Arawak Indians first inhabited St. John and the petroglyphs they hand-carved on many of the rock surfaces centuries ago still remain. Despite the island’s popularity, it has been minimally developed in keeping with its pristine environment. The ferry rides to and from St. John will present the highlights of St. Thomas’ southern coast. You will see long stretches of beautiful beachfront, rimmed by unspoiled turquoise waters. With its backdrop of lush tropical foliage blanketing the hills, the south shore couldn’t be more picture perfect.
excursions.hint:
• Dress in weather-appropriate clothing.
  • Wear flat comfortable walking shoes or aqua socks.
excursions.disclaimer: This tour cannot accommodate wheelchairs or scooters. Guests must be able to walk up to 300 yards and feel comfortable climbing and descending ten stairs to board and disembark the vessel.

excursions.title: ACCESSIBLE MOUNTAIN TOP &  BEACH BREAK–
excursions.highlights:
• Capture beautiful views and photos from the highest point of St. Thomas, Mountain Top, 1500 feet above sea level.
  • Enjoy a snack on your own or do some souvenir shopping at the beautiful Paradise Point.
  • Relax on an accessible beach with accessible restrooms and a beach wheelchair available.
excursions.description:
OVERVIEW

STT-AC1 Non Mobility Equipment

This excursion is for guests that use a cane/walker, have limited mobility issues or for companions of those guest that have booked mobility equipment tour.

Those guests that are fully dependent on their mobility device please book: STT-AC2-ACCESSIBLE MOUNTAIN TOP & BEACH BREAK Mobility Equipment User

This St. Thomas shore excursion combines the best highlights of the island, including Mountain Top and Paradise Point, with some relaxing time at an accessible beach. Start your tour by meeting your tour guide/driver and accessible van at the cruise dock. From here, you’ll set out on a beautiful scenic drive that includes views of the Atlantic, the neighboring islands and many fascinating landmarks unique to the island. Your first stop of the day will be the highest point on the island, the popular Mountain Top viewpoint. Here, you can take some beautiful vacation photos and browse the massive gift shop with many different island crafts and souvenirs. Next, you’ll continue to the beautiful Paradise Point. From this spectacular place, you will have a panoramic view of the capital city Charlotte Amalie, and have time to sit down, relax and enjoy a snack, meal or drink on your own in the open-air restaurant/bar onsite.

Finally, the last stop of your day will be one of the beautiful accessible beaches on the island. Spend some time enjoying the ocean breeze and Caribbean water, before returning to your cruise ship. The accessible beach is equipped with accessible restrooms and also has one accessible beach wheelchair available to share.
excursions.hint:
• Dress in weather-appropriate clothing.
  • Wear flat comfortable walking shoes.
excursions.disclaimer: This tour is designed to be accessible for all guests. The tour route avoids steps and stairs. Accessible bathrooms with wide doors for wheelchairs are present along the tour route. An accessible vehicle with a wheelchair lift or ramp will be used for transportation. Guides are not allowed to push wheelchairs. The price includes a vehicle, tour guide and entrance tickets. Lunch/snack costs are not included. The number of accessible vehicles are extremely limited. Guests are encouraged to make their accessible shore excursion reservations as far in advance as possible.
